faqs.question: What is Shamrock Bail School?
faqs.answer: Shamrock Bail School is the education division of Shamrock Bail Bonds. We offer Florida pre-licensing programs: a 20-Hour Correspondence Course ($199) and a 120-Hour Basic Certification Training ($649) that includes a 1-year State Exam Simulator and Bail Mentor AI pass.

faqs.question: Do I need any prior experience?
faqs.answer: No prior industry experience is required. Both programs are designed for new students. Florida licensure still requires age 18+, a high school diploma or GED, U.S. citizenship or legal residency, and a clean background check.

faqs.question: How much does the 120-hour course cost?
faqs.answer: The 120-Hour Pre-Licensing Course is $649 (list $1,200) via secure SwipeSimple checkout. Tuition includes 1-year access to the State Exam Simulator and Bail Mentor AI.

faqs.question: How much is the 20-Hour Correspondence Course?
faqs.answer: The 20-Hour Correspondence Pre-Licensing Course is $199 (list $299). It is fully online and self-paced with automated FLDFS statutory time tracking.

faqs.question: Do I get a certificate?
faqs.answer: Yes. Completing either pre-licensing course provides an official digital certificate. The 120-Hour program prepares you to sit for the Florida DFS state licensing exam.

faqs.question: Can I take courses from anywhere in Florida?
faqs.answer: Yes. The 20-Hour Correspondence Course is fully online and self-paced. The 120-Hour Course uses live interactive webinars and hybrid cohorts.

faqs.question: Is the State Exam Simulator included?
faqs.answer: Yes. The 120-Hour Course includes a free 1-year Bail Mentor AI and State Exam Simulator pass. A standalone simulator pass is also available for $49.

faqs.question: How do I become a licensed bail bondsman in Florida?
faqs.answer: Florida requires completing a state-approved 120-hour pre-licensing course, passing the DFS state exam, obtaining a surety appointment, and completing a supervised internship. Our 120-Hour Basic Certification Training covers the pre-licensing curriculum and exam prep.
